description: Used to transfer your PF accumulation from your previous employer's trust/EPFO office to the current employer's account when switching jobs.

fields.name: Employee Name
fields.description: Your full name as appearing in EPFO / employer records.

fields.name: Father's / Husband's Name
fields.description: Father's name for unmarried; husband's name for married female employees.

fields.name: Date of Birth
fields.description: Date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.

fields.name: Present PF Account Number (New)
fields.description: The full PF account number allotted by your current/new employer.

fields.name: Date of Joining Current Employer
fields.description: The date you joined the new organisation.

fields.name: Name of Current Establishment
fields.description: Full name of the company/factory where you are currently employed.

fields.name: Address of Current Establishment
fields.description: Complete address of the new employer.

fields.name: Previous PF Account Number (Old)
fields.description: Your PF account number from the previous employer that you want to transfer FROM.

fields.name: Name & Address of Previous Establishment
fields.description: Full name and address of your previous employer.

fields.name: Date of Leaving Previous Employer
fields.description: Exact date of leaving the previous job.

fields.name: Reason for Transfer
fields.description: Resignation / Retrenchment / Retirement / Death (if filing by nominee).

fields.name: Pension Contribution Details
fields.description: Tick if you also want to transfer the EPS (Pension) balance along with PF.

fields.name: Employee Signature
fields.description: Sign at the bottom certifying the details are correct.

fields.name: Current Employer Certification
fields.description: To be certified by the new employer — certifying employment and account details.

fields.name: Previous Employer Certification (if needed)
fields.description: In case online transfer fails, the previous employer may also need to certify.
